parts.name: Switch (Left Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left switch handle of the faucet, made of stainless steel, used to control water flow or temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn on/off or adjust the water temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to open or close the water valve.

parts.name: Switch (Right Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right switch handle of the faucet, made of stainless steel, used to control water flow or temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn on/off or adjust the water temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to open or close the water valve.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet, made of stainless steel, through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water flow from the internal plumbing to the sink basin.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Frame (Spout Base)
parts.Basic_description: This is the base frame of the spout, made of stainless steel, connecting the spout to the wall or sink.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and seals the spout to prevent leaks.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a fixed mounting point.

parts.name: Frame (Left Handle Base)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left handle base frame, made of stainless steel, connecting the left switch to the wall or sink.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the left handle and houses the valve mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed while the handle rotates.

parts.name: Frame (Right Handle Base)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right handle base frame, made of stainless steel, connecting the right switch to the wall or sink.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the right handle and houses the valve mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed while the handle rotates.
